body:
First raised: 2026-10-05 (America/Los_Angeles), during the subject-by-subject review in #405.

## Finding and scope

The exact 11 Cook Islands members in #405 currently use Natural Earth 1:10m Admin1 fallback polygons. Its generalized features are public domain and provide a useful comparator, but do not establish statutory island boundaries, dry-land completeness, lagoon masks, or inclusion of named small islets. The 2026 official shipping-policy lists establish Northern/Southern service groups, not the geometry or administrative role of each atlas island. Prior #502/#512 identity and label/parent corrections for COK-4951 and COK-4956 are complete and must not be repeated; this task concerns boundaries/source suitability for these exact existing IDs only.

Subjects: `COK-4950`, `COK-4951`, `COK-4952`, `COK-4953`, `COK-4954`, `COK-4955`, `COK-4956`, `COK-4959`, `COK-4960`, `COK-4961`, `COK-4962`.

The initial evidence and source crosswalk are in #405 and PR #1054. The retained scoped Natural Earth source extract SHA-256 is `dd3f4a5683c713fd89c00b41748d89771f905ef236feaacb7887818085f3d96e`; the original global Admin1 restoration pin and public-domain terms are recorded in that packet.

## Acceptance

- For each exact subject, establish physical island/atoll identity, current parent and any administrative or service role from primary Cook Islands sources; keep service groups distinct from legal boundaries.
- Investigate every named land component, lagoon/water treatment, source vintage and neighboring granularity against lawful current island-scale evidence. Resolve source completeness or preserve explicit unresolved limits; a same-name polygon, member count or overlap ratio alone is insufficient.
- Retain lawful source bytes or exact restoration instructions, retrieval dates, source hashes, terms, pinned baseline and reproducible findings/controls.
- Preserve IDs, parents, history, release pins and #502/#512 corrections. Geography evidence and engineering handoff only; do not edit shared geography or production data.
- Link sourced bounded engineering/restoration proposals for any supported correction, and obtain an independent exact-head review through the normal queue.

This is not a certification of the Cook Islands region or permission to import historical attributes.

## Dependency and ownership

This issue depends on completion of #405. Begin only after #405 is merged/closed so its exact source/restoration inputs are available on current main. Own only `data/regional-review/cook-islands-boundaries-20261005/`.
